set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: if $virtual then 'Simulating off-screen signal-leak survey at ' + $station.knownname else 'Decoding station signal leak at ' + $station.knownname

do_if.value: not this.ship.isplayerowned or this.ship == player.occupiedship or this.ship.order != @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_order or not $station.isoperational or $station.isplayerowned or this.ship.sector != $station.sector or $station.ishostileto.{this.ship} or not $leak.exists or this.ship.distanceto.{$leak} gt (if $virtual then 6km else 1km) + (this.ship.size + $leak.size) / 2 or (not $virtual and $leak.islocked) or ($virtual and $station.sector == player.sector and $station.attention ge attention.visible)
not $virtual and $leak.object.isphysicsready and this.ship.attention ge attention.visible

not $valid or player.age lt $started + 15s or not $station.isoperational or not $leak.exists or this.ship.order != @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_order or this.ship == player.occupiedship or $station.ishostileto.{this.ship}
